note_zh: 所有引用均来自公开可核验来源；reliability 字段标注来源等级，confidence 标注本方案对该数据的采信程度。
note_en: All citations come from publicly verifiable sources; 'reliability' marks the source tier and 'confidence' marks how strongly this proposal relies on it.

sources.title_zh: 百年京张 AI 创新带城市设计开源征集 · Agent 任务书与提交规则
sources.title_en: Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt Urban Design Open Call - Agent Taskbook and Submission Rules
sources.note_zh: 征集方发布的任务书、提交包契约、几何与指标规则、校验反馈规范
sources.note_en: Organizer-published taskbook, submission-package contract, geometry/metrics rules and validator-feedback spec

sources.title_zh: 场地包 / 设计任务基础数据（三级范围与重点区域）
sources.title_en: Site package / design-task base data (three scope levels and key areas)
sources.note_zh: 统筹研究范围 43.6 km²、总体设计范围 11.4 km²、重点区域 368.4 ha（众智园 192.1 / 原点社区 104.3 / 大钟寺 72.0）
sources.note_en: Coordinated research area 43.6 km2, overall design area 11.4 km2, key areas 368.4 ha (192.1 / 104.3 / 72.0)

sources.title_zh: 京张铁路遗址公园建设进展报道
sources.title_en: Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park progress reports
sources.publisher: 海淀区人民政府 / 北京市园林绿化局 / 瞭望东方周刊
sources.note_zh: 全长约 9 km；'三道一绿'绿化面积约 62.07 ha；服务沿线 70 余个社区、约 45 万居民；一期获 2025 美国景观设计师协会国家奖；二期推进西直门至北五环贯通
sources.note_en: About 9 km long; 'three paths one green' greenery about 62.07 ha; serves 70+ communities and about 450,000 residents; Phase 1 received a 2025 ASLA national award; Phase 2 advances the Xizhimen-North 5th Ring connection

sources.title_zh: 2025 海淀人工智能创新图鉴
sources.publisher: 新京报贝壳财经 × 中关村科学城
sources.note_zh: 海淀 AI 企业 1900+（约占全市七成）、备案大模型 123 款、AI 独角兽 26 家、AI2000 顶尖学者 135 人次（约占全国 40%）
sources.note_en: 1900+ AI enterprises (about 70% of the city), 123 filed large models, 26 AI unicorns, 135 person-times AI2000 top scholars (about 40% nationwide)

sources.title_zh: 全球创新街区对标案例集（8 例，见下列分项来源）
sources.title_en: Global innovation-district benchmark set (8 cases, itemised below)
sources.note_zh: 本方案 8 个对标案例的汇总条目，具体依据见 SRC-STATIONF / SRC-ONENORTH / SRC-CANADA / SRC-KINGSCROSS / SRC-HIGHLINE / SRC-KENDALL / SRC-ZHANGJIANG / SRC-HETAO
sources.note_en: Umbrella entry for the 8 benchmarks; see the itemised sources for each case

sources.title_zh: Station F（巴黎）· 由 1927 年铁路货运站改造的全球最大创业园区
sources.title_en: Station F, Paris - world's largest startup campus converted from a 1927 rail freight depot
sources.note_zh: 原 Halle Freyssinet 铁路货运站（1927 年建，2012 年列为历史建筑），约 34,000 m²，2017 年开园，常年容纳约 1000 家创业企业，为欧洲最大 AI 创业社区。与京张铁路遗址再利用高度可比。
sources.note_en: Former Halle Freyssinet rail freight depot (built 1927, listed 2012), about 34,000 sqm, opened 2017, hosts about 1,000 startups, Europe's largest AI startup community. Directly comparable to Jing-Zhang rail heritage reuse.

sources.title_zh: one-north（新加坡）· 200 公顷研发商务园区
sources.title_en: one-north, Singapore - 200-hectare research and business park
sources.note_zh: 2001 年启动，JTC 主导，扎哈·哈迪德事务所总体规划；200 ha、8 个主题片区；400+ 领军企业、800 家创业企业、16 家公共研究机构、约 4.6 万知识工作者；16 ha 中央公园串联各片区；保留黑白殖民时期洋房；新加坡首个无人机测试片区与城市级 living lab。面积与众智园（192.1 ha）高度可比。
sources.note_en: Launched 2001, led by JTC, masterplan by Zaha Hadid Architects; 200 ha in 8 thematic precincts; 400+ leading companies, 800 startups, 16 public research institutes, about 46,000 knowledge workers; a 16 ha park links the precincts; conserved black-and-white colonial bungalows; Singapore's first drone estate and city-scale living lab. Scale closely comparable to Zhongzhiyuan (192.1 ha).

sources.title_zh: 泛加拿大人工智能战略与'AI 三角区'
sources.title_en: Pan-Canadian AI Strategy and the Canadian AI Triangle
sources.note_zh: 多伦多 Vector Institute、蒙特利尔 Mila、埃德蒙顿 Amii 三极分工协同，形成国家级 AI 能力网络
sources.note_en: Vector Institute (Toronto), Mila (Montreal) and Amii (Edmonton) form a nationally coordinated three-pole AI capability network

sources.title_zh: 伦敦国王十字知识区（King's Cross Knowledge Quarter）
sources.note_zh: 由废弃铁路调车场与货运用地整体再生，集聚 Google/DeepMind 总部、弗朗西斯·克里克研究所、中央圣马丁学院等；铁路棚屋等工业遗产被改造为公共与学术空间
sources.note_en: Regenerated from disused railway yards and goods lands; hosts Google/DeepMind headquarters, the Francis Crick Institute and Central Saint Martins; railway sheds and industrial heritage converted into public and academic space

sources.title_zh: 纽约高线公园（The High Line）
sources.note_zh: 废弃高架货运铁路改造为线性公园，带动切尔西与哈德逊广场沿线大规模再开发，是'线性遗产触媒型更新'的经典范例
sources.note_en: A disused elevated freight rail viaduct converted into a linear park, catalysing large-scale redevelopment along Chelsea and Hudson Yards; the classic case of linear-heritage catalytic regeneration

sources.title_zh: 波士顿肯德尔广场创新街区（Kendall Square / MIT）
sources.title_en: Kendall Square innovation district, Cambridge MA (MIT)
sources.publisher: MIT Investment Management Company / City of Cambridge
sources.note_zh: 以 MIT 为核心的高密度产学研混合街区，被广泛视为全球单位面积创新产出最高的地区之一；强调小街区、步行可达与实验室—企业—住宅混合
sources.note_en: A high-density university-industry district anchored by MIT, widely regarded as among the most innovation-dense areas globally; emphasises small blocks, walkability and lab-firm-housing mixing

sources.title_zh: 上海张江人工智能岛 / 张江科学城
sources.title_en: Zhangjiang AI Island / Zhangjiang Science City, Shanghai
sources.publisher: 上海市浦东新区人民政府
sources.note_zh: 以'AI 岛'为集中承载空间，采用场景开放 + 龙头企业集聚 + 滨水公共空间一体化的组织方式
sources.note_en: Uses the 'AI Island' as a concentrated carrier space, combining open scenarios, anchor-firm clustering and integrated waterfront public space

sources.title_zh: 河套深港科技创新合作区
sources.title_en: Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Cooperation Zone
sources.note_zh: 以制度创新与跨境要素流动为核心的科创合作区，可为创新带的政策试验与'监管沙盒'提供参照
sources.note_en: An innovation cooperation zone centred on institutional innovation and cross-boundary factor flows; a reference for policy experimentation and regulatory sandboxes in the belt

sources.title_zh: 城市用地分类与规划建设用地标准 GB 50137-2011
sources.title_en: Code for Classification of Urban Land Use and Planning Standards of Development Land GB 50137-2011
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.note_zh: 本方案 land_use.geojson 的用地代码（R2/B1/B2/A3/M4/U1/S1/G1/G3）依据该标准体系表达
sources.note_en: Land-use codes in land_use.geojson (R2/B1/B2/A3/M4/U1/S1/G1/G3) follow this standard

sources.title_zh: 城市综合交通体系规划标准 GB/T 51328-2018
sources.title_en: Standard for Urban Comprehensive Transport System Planning GB/T 51328-2018
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.note_zh: 路网密度校核依据；本方案 road_network_density_km_per_sqkm = 8.35 km/km²，达到城市建成区路网密度不低于 8 km/km² 的导向要求
sources.note_en: Basis for the road-network density check; this proposal reaches 8.35 km/km2, meeting the guidance of no less than 8 km/km2 for built-up areas

sources.title_zh: 城市居住区规划设计标准 GB 50180-2018
sources.title_en: Standard for Urban Residential Area Planning and Design GB 50180-2018
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.note_zh: 生活圈配套与公共绿地布局依据；本方案以 5 分钟/15 分钟生活圈组织人才社区服务
sources.note_en: Basis for living-circle facilities and public green layout; the proposal organises talent-community services on 5-minute and 15-minute living circles

sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.note_zh: 遗址公园慢行主脊与站城广场的无障碍连续性依据
sources.note_en: Basis for accessibility continuity along the heritage greenway spine and station squares

sources.title_zh: 北京城市总体规划（2016年—2035年）
sources.note_zh: 上位法定规划；涉及减量提质、历史文化名城保护、三山五园视廊等约束，本方案高度与风貌控制以其为上位依据（具体分区指标待官方下发）
sources.note_en: Statutory upper-level plan; covers reduction-and-quality growth, historic city protection and Three-Hills-Five-Gardens view corridors. Height and character controls defer to it (specific district indicators pending official release).
